scope: Six-size reading index, real keyboard Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter, pointer doubleclick and independent touch doubletaps, exact current/legacy world and autosave, frozen evidence, cross-location, explicit pass and stale-route boundaries.
qualification: Independent touch gestures are separated by700ms and assert first native click detail1; immediate second tap remains tested. An earlier detail2/3 continuation after scripted scrolling is retained as a failed excluded cross-gesture sequence, not evidence that every continuous tap pattern passes.
limits: Automated Chromium, not human balance/physical-device/screen-reader certification
Full comparison terms remain long; only the focused reading index is claimed to expose all five large-text destinations together
Independent QA does not replace final aggregate or remote CI
